Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances globally, in AMER, EMEA or APAC regions. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will: Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus etc. Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person Valued Skills And Experience Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies. Excellent communication and presentation skills What We Offer Colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. review_candidates.title: IT L2 Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Who Are We? Volkswagen Group Services is a Volkswagen Group company oriented towards working for Group companies worldwide. We provide services in the areas of production, logistics, data engineering (IT), engineering, consulting, quality, business services, human resources, communication, and administrative and financial services. We are focused on our clients’ activities and take responsibility for carrying them out on their behalf. We are currently hiring an IT Operations Engineer Level 2 to join our IT Operations Hub team for our new projects in Spain . As part of a newly established operations service, you will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of critical digital products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and contribute to defining operational processes, service standards, and best practices from the ground up within an international and collaborative environment. What Will Your Responsibilities Be? Take over incidents from Level 1 and resolve them within Level 2 scope, across connectivity, FOTA/OTA, telematics, remote diagnostics and fleet APIs. Diagnose across the stack: application logs, interfaces, APIs, cloud services and device-to-cloud communication. Execute and monitor FOTA/OTA campaigns, validating rollout and, where required, rollback. Escalate to Level 3 development with a documented, reproducible case — reproduction steps, logs, scope of impact and what has already been ruled out. Run the recurring operational tasks of the service: monitoring, health checks, batch job supervision and interface monitoring. Write and maintain the runbooks and work instructions for every system under service. Absorb the knowledge transfer from the current teams, system by system, as each wave enters the service. Support major incident resolution under the coordination of the Incident Management Coordinator. Contribute to shift-left: automate, document or push back to Level 1 whatever repeats. Cover the Incident Management Coordinator seat during rotation, once cross-trained. What Requirements Are We Looking For? Qualifications & General Experience Degree in computer science, telecommunications, electronic engineering or a related field — or equivalent professional experience, which we weigh equally. 3–5 years in Level 2 support, application operations or platform operations. Experience in an SLA-driven service environment. Experience working in an international, distributed team. Technical Requirements 3–5 years in Level 2 support of cloud-hosted applications or connected products. AWS in daily operational use: EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM basics and log analysis. Certification is welcome but evidence of use matters more. Linux command line, and scripting in Python or Bash for diagnosis and routine automation. API troubleshooting: REST and JSON, request tracing, reading API and gateway logs, working with Postman or equivalent. SQL at diagnostic level — able to query a database to confirm or discard a hypothesis. Monitoring and observability tooling: CloudWatch, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog or similar. ITSM tooling in daily use: JIRA, Confluence and ideally ServiceNow. Technical writing in English — runbooks, work instructions and escalation cases. English B2–C1. Nice to Have Connected vehicle, IoT or telematics architectures: device-to-cloud communication, MQTT, OTA update mechanisms. Experience operating or supporting an OTA / firmware update platform. Automotive sector experience, or experience inside the Volkswagen Group. CI/CD exposure and infrastructure-as-code basics (Terraform, CloudFormation). Container platforms: Docker, Kubernetes. German, at any working level. Experience working in multinational environments. Exposure to cloud technologies, monitoring platforms, or modern digital service environments. Experience supporting large-scale enterprise applications. Personal competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned activities. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively within international teams. A proactive attitude focused on continuous improvement. Customer and service orientation. Ability to work under pressure. Working Hours The service operates between 05:00 and 23:00 CET, Monday to Friday , with coverage organised through rotating shifts. Early Shift: 05:00 – 13:00 Central Shift: 08:00 – 16:00 Late Shift: 15:00 – 23:00 Please note that part of the schedule falls within the legally established night-work period. Applicable shift and night-work premiums will be provided in accordance with the relevant collective agreement and in addition to the gross annual salary. This position is offered under a full remote working model within Spain . What We Can Offer 100% Remote Work Model in Spain Home Office Equipment Support Flex Work Schedule International Remote Work Policy Career Development Trainings Monthly Extra Allowances VW Group and Partnership Brands Discounts Employee Support Program For more information on our data processing activities and your rights as a data subject, please consult our privacy policy. Ref: Level A
